name: Strakka Flexline Cargo Short
description: Knee-length cargo shorts in a durable stretch-twill, popular in the warmer interior zones of Meridian where warehouse climate control is unreliable. Four cargo pockets with velcro-close flaps and a reinforced back panel. Usually olive, khaki, or faded black. Worn with compression sleeves by workers whose chrome starts below the knee.
functionality: Reinforced back panel, velcro-close cargo pockets
what_it_says: Practical and unbothered — you prioritize function over appearance and you're probably working somewhere warm.
story_hooks: The wide cargo pockets are a known concealment point; port security at several Meridian freight hubs has standing orders to check the velcro flaps.
A worker who pairs these with expensive chrome legs is sending a message: they spent their money on what matters to them.
